title: When set-aside required.
bodyText: When a shortage as defined in section 125C-2 exists, all prime suppliers shall set aside supplies of each petroleum product for which there is a shortage. The amount set aside shall be in accordance with the rules adopted by the chief energy officer of the Hawaii state energy office.
bodyHtml: §125C-22  When set-aside required.  When a shortage as defined in section 125C-2 exists, all prime suppliers shall set aside supplies of each petroleum product for which there is a shortage.  The amount set aside shall be in accordance with the rules adopted by the chief energy officer of the Hawaii state energy office. [L 1984, c 238, pt of §7; am L 2019, c 122, §3]
